selected_controls.expected_assertion: Attempt issuer/current-source DML and verifier business DML or role assumption
Actual issuer issues/selects own grants and performs one-way revoke only; tuple/scope rewrite, delete, self-attested currentness and business writes deny.
App/worker direct grant CRUD, TRUNCATE, CREATE and SET ROLE issuer/helper/verifier/schema owner deny.
NOLOGIN helper/verifiers are exercised only through named functions; no login, raw body output, business DML or broader inherited privilege.
Explicitly labeled local browser/service-role simulations cannot execute protected helpers or access internal schemas; no hosted Data API parity inferred.
